structuredInspection: Reporter keys are configuration, test suites/results, diagnostics and attachment path metadata. No storage-state, request/header/environment or embedded attachment-body objects. Source snippets retain function references but no returned pairing/CSRF/cookie values.
limitation: Author structured/manual and pattern audit, not universal proof of absence of secrets. Previously sanitized trace ZIPs remain separately labelled; no raw private traces copied.
